tagline: The home bakery: cheeses, fermented products, bread and pastries explained step by step
description: QKB is a home cooking magazine dedicated to the domestic kitchen: fresh cheeses, kefir and fermented cheeses, sourdough, bread, Spanish pastries and preserves, with proven recipes and food safety criteria.
author: QKB Workshop

quesos-caseros.name: Homemade cheeses
quesos-caseros.description: Fresh cheese, cottage cheese, mozzarella and labneh in the kitchen at home, with safe milk and simple technique.

kefir-y-fermentados.name: Kefir and fermented
kefir-y-fermentados.description: Milk and water kefir, yogurt, kombucha and fermented vegetables, with hygiene and patience.

masa-madre-y-pan.name: sourdough and bread
masa-madre-y-pan.description: Create and care for sourdough, understand flours and bake loaves, ciabattas and sliced bread.

bolleria.name: Spanish pastries
bolleria.description: Homemade croissants, ensaimadas, muffins, roscón, torrijas and churros.

conservas.name: Preserves and pickles
conservas.description: Jams, pickles, seasoned olives and homemade preserves with safety criteria.

tecnica.name: Workshop technique
tecnica.description: Temperature, salt, yeast, utensils and hygiene: the basis that makes everything turn out well.
